$comment: HAND-EDITED per-row facts of the settings schema that are not a row's own definition. kept_on_reset_all: keys Reset All Settings leaves alone, the look picked at onboarding (the app theme and the terminal font), which each row still resets (SettingsController.resetAllSettings). shared_with_browser: cmux-next keys cmux-browser reads too (cmux-browser #567 moved its copies to cmux.json); their consumers are cmux-next and cmux-browser (rows moved to schemas/settings/source say so themselves, in their consumers). validation: how another validator checks a row's value: portable (the export's fixed rule and samples), or domain:<name> when only the app knows the valid values (theme names, installed fonts, system sounds) or the value has its own shape; keys wins over kinds. scripts/cmux-next/gen-settings-sources.py writes the Swift copy (SettingsSchema+RowFacts.generated.swift); the schema export writes kept_on_reset_all, consumers and validation per row from it.
